content: Reactivation after unpaid periods: industry norm is IN-TERM reactivation - hold the subscription rather than cancel, then on payment-method update retry the outstanding invoice and instantly restore access on the original billing rhythm, without a new start date. Requiring the customer to settle ALL missed months before reactivation is unusual for access/seat SaaS (it is a utility/telecom pattern) and raises a price wall that commonly converts recoverable churn into permanent churn. Gateways do not natively support 'pay N months of arrears to reactivate': Stripe canceled is terminal and needs a brand-new subscription; unpaid keeps generating draft invoices that are never charged. Building arrears collection means custom invoice logic layered on the gateway.
